text: ぼくらの　ひそひそ　ばなしを　ぬすみ　ぎき　してる　やつは！

structure.jp: ぼくらの　ひそひそ　ばなしを
ぬすみ　ぎき　してる　やつは！
structure.en: the guy who's eavesdropping on it (who is it)?!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぬすみ　ぎき　してる　やつ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a word describes that word. ぬすみ　ぎき　してる　やつ = 'the guy who is eavesdropping'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the casual short form of ている, which shows something is going on right now. してる = 'is doing'.
